biblStruct.note: An edition and German translation of the anonymous reworking of Yefet b. Eli’s Judaeo-Arabic translation of Joel from Ms. Hunt. 206 of the Bodleian Library, the Hebrew script of which is transcribed by Schröter into Arabic characters. On the later identification of this Ms. with Yefet’s work see, inter alios, P. Birnbaum’s 1942 edition of Yefet on Hosea and E. Schlossberg’s 2000 Pe‘amim article. (Biblia Arabica)
